create_CsvReader: create a CsvReader instance to read data from CSV files as separate documents
build_CsvReader_compressed: build a CsvReader with gzip compression to read compressed CSV files from a data folder
test_CsvReader_limit: test the CsvReader with a limit parameter to read only a subset of documents for debugging
refactor_CsvReader_adapter: refactor the CsvReader with a custom adapter function to transform data dicts into Document objects
summarize_CsvReader_read_file: summarize the CsvReader.read_file method that yields documents from each CSV row
